capabilities: Register selected text from Markdown editing or reading view as a dated record
Add milestones, birthdays, anniversaries, and future deadlines manually
Group records into Days remaining, Today, and Days elapsed sections
Display spans in days, months, years, or combined formats
Archive entries and keep clickable links to their source notes
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins directory; install via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases. Works locally and offline with no telemetry. Interface follows Obsidian's display language in Japanese and English.
motivation: The author built it on the belief that life becomes richer as you uncover and gather more anniversaries of your own.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to collect chosen dates from notes and see the elapsed or remaining span between each one and today.
summary: Date-span tracker that lets you pick meaningful dates from your notes and shows how much time has passed or remains until today.
